title: Diomedes and Athena wound Ares
intro: Athena deflects Ares' thrust and guides Diomedes' spear home. Ares' cry terrifies both armies.

notes.text: βριθοσύνη, weight: dat sg, cause of the axle's groan. ἄγω, carry: unaugmented 3sg impf; axle / chariot the subject.
λάζομαι, grasp: unaugmented 3sg impf. μάστιξ, whip: acc sg; ἡνία, reins: acc neut pl.
ἔχω: unaugmented 3sg impf, “drove at Ares first”; echoes the imperative at 829. μώνυχας, solid-hoofed.
πελώριος, huge; ἐξεναρίζω, slay / strip of armour: 3sg impf.
ὄχα, far / by far, strengthens superlative; ἀγλαός, splendid / illustrious.
Blood-stained / blood-polluted; epithet of Ares.
δύνω, put on: unaugmented 3sg impf, δῦνε; κυνέη, cap / helmet; Ἄϊδος, of Hades. This cap conceals Athena.
εἶδον, see: 3sg 2aor opt, negative purpose, “so Ares would not see her.” ὄβριμος, mighty.
Mortal-destroying; βροτός + λοιγός, destruction.
αὐτόθι, right there; ἐάω, leave / allow: 3sg aor; κεῖμαι pres inf, lie. Ares leaves Periphas' body.
ἐξαίνυμαι, take away: unaugmented 3sg impf mid; θυμός, life here.
βαίνω unaugmented 3sg root aor; ἰθύς + gen, straight towards; ἱππόδαμος, horse-taming.
σχεδόν, near; εἶμι, go: pres ptc nom pl. The usual formula for combatants closing.
πρόσθεν, first / before the other; ὀρέγω, reach / thrust: 3sg aor mid.
ὑπέρ + acc, over the yoke and reins; path of Ares' spear.
μέμονα perf act ptc nom sg, eager; αἱρέω 2aor mid inf. ἀπὸ θυμόν, “take away his life.”
τό = the spear; χείρ dat sg; λαμβάνω 2aor act ptc nom fem sg, stem λαβ-.
ὠθέω, push: 3sg aor; ὑπέκ + gen, out from under / away below the chariot.
ἐτώσιος, fruitless / ineffectual, with the spear; ἀΐσσω, dart: aor pass inf, result, “to dart harmlessly away.”
δεύτερος, in his turn / second; ὁρμάομαι, charge: 3sg impf mid.
ἐπερείδω, press / drive in: 3sg aor act. Athena supplies the force behind the thrust.
νείατος, lowest; κενεών, flank / lower belly: acc sg.
ζώννυμι, gird: iterative impf mid; μίτρη, protective waist-band: dat sg.
οὐτάω, stab: epic 3sg aor; τυγχάνω, hit: 2aor ptc nom sg; “struck him there.”
χρώς, skin / flesh: epic acc sg; δάπτω, tear / rend: 3sg aor. διά separated from the verb, “tore through.”
σπάω, pull out: unaugmented 3sg aor. βράχω, roar: 3sg 2aor; Ares now the subject.
Nine thousand … ten thousand; ἐπιάχω, shout: unaugmented 3pl impf, “as [so many men] shout.”
συνάγω, join: pres ptc nom pl; ξυν- = συν-. “Joining in the strife of war”; Ares also names warfare itself.
τρόμος, trembling: subject; αἱρέω 3sg 2aor, “seized”; ὑπό with the verb reinforces the seizing image.
δείδω, fear: aor act ptc acc pl with both armies. ἆτος, insatiate, + gen “of war.”
“Like the dark haze…”; ἐρεβεννός, murky / Erebus-dark; ἀήρ fem here, mist / cloud-bank. τοῖος at 866 answers οἵη.
καῦμα, heat: gen sg; postposed ἐξ, “out of / after heat.”
Gen absolute: “as a harsh-blowing wind arises”; δυσαής, ill-blowing / stormy; ὄρνυμαι pres mid ptc.
“Such [Ares appeared] to Diomedes”; dat of observer. The verb completes the simile on the next page.
